title:
Transforms sensor alert timestamps by converting them to the user's timezone
and formatting them for display in the UI.

This transform processes objects that contain sensorAlert data and
1. Converts sensor alert timestamps to the user's configured timezone
2. Formats the timestamp for display using the pattern `MM/dd/y, hh:mm a`
3. Updates the formattedTimestamp field on the sensor alert object
name: TransformSensorAlertTimestamp
